channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Anthony Tolliver | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Anthony Tolliver from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Ed Stefanski on Anthony Tolliver
item.description:
“I was with James in Memphis. Anthony Tolliver -- the people in Detroit, teammates and everybody -- loves the guy, so they're still in play. It's all going to depend what kind of money is out there and the demand for both those players. More I'd say the ball's in their court than ours.”

Ed Stefanski on Anthony Tolliver, Jun 28, 2018. Source: Booth Newspapers.
